evidence: Raises the minimum C++ standard to C++23 in CMakeLists.txt, depends/Makefile, and CI configuration, bumping the minimum compiler versions to GCC 13 and Clang 19.
rationale: Raising the baseline toolchain to C++23 is a strategic compiler and dependency transition that affects all build platforms and contributor environments. It enables modern language idioms and removes accumulated build workarounds across the repository.
